parties.respondent: The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Dependants' eligibility in motor accident compensation; major married/earning children not automatically excluded; reliance on National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Birender; cohabitation and financial dependence relevant; future prospects @30% allowed; High Court's 50% deduction set aside; dependency of sons and daughter upheld; compensation recalculated with 1/4th deduction and multiplier 13; total awarded Rs.37,80,681/-.
legal_provisions_cited: National Insurance Company Limited v. Birender & Ors. (2020) 11 SCC 356
National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi (2017) 16 SCC Para 42, 52 & 59
final_judgment: Civil appeal allowed; High Court modification set aside; compensation enhanced to Rs.37,80,681/- with interest as awarded by Tribunal; MACT award further modified accordingly.
